g.text: Local publication and whole-topic authority replacement
admit complete topic group / obtain grants
persist current epoch and private grants
read via read Proxy, compute and retain candidate
verify all preparations and disjoint ownership
register exact requests, digests and counts
publish with captured token and epoch
Keep topic ownership. No replacement or retirement
while this group's write outcome remains unknown.
persist switch intent, drain dispatched work
require same input placement and fresh empty output
rotate whole topic group under publication lock
atomically revoke old grants and persist larger epoch
install new grants against old completed heads
preserve state, cursors and open windows
reset with expected old heads after revocation
new deployment, sequence one, cursors zero
record active epoch and ownership transfer
restored OLD candidate with captured OLD grant
Old-token denial leaves output end offsets unchanged.
Cached durable acknowledgements are safe HTTP retries.
There is no atomic publication across workers or gateway HA.
